title: Indiana Code Title 32, Article 31 (Landlord-Tenant Relations)
source_id: IC 32-31 (security deposits IC 32-31-3; rental agreements and access IC 32-31-5; tenant obligations IC 32-31-7; landlord obligations IC 32-31-8)
verified_how: Read the register's own 2026 Title 32 data file https://iga.in.gov/ic/2026/Title_32.json in the browser (HTTP 200, 2130 entries): article '32-31' name 'ARTICLE 31. LANDLORD-TENANT RELATIONS' with chapters 'Chapter 3. Security Deposits', 'Chapter 5. Rental Agreements; Right of Access', 'Chapter 7. Tenant Obligations' and 'Chapter 8. Landlord Obligations Under a Rental Agreement'; all year '2026', public true.
notes: Tenancy was chosen as the principal statute for this combined topic because its rules (deposit deadlines, notice periods, repair duties) are the computable ones. The consumer half of the topic is the Deceptive Consumer Sales Act, IC 24-5-0.5, which was not separately fetched and so is named here only as a pointer.
